en.Por setenta anos, ninguém viu a cabeça t: This fish hid its see-through head from us for seventy years!
en.Os olhos-tubo giram: pra cima, pra achar: Its tube eyes rotate: up to find food, and forward to eat it.
en.Cientistas acham que ele rouba comida de: Scientists think it steals food from venomous tentacles, and its head works like a helmet. Genius!
